5576: local previous_incVim = _M.incVim
5577: function _M:incVim(v)
5578: 	if v < 0 then
5579: 		local mult = 2
5580: 		if self:attr("bloodcasting") then mult = self:attr("bloodcasting") / 100 end
5581: 
5582: 		local cost = math.abs(v)
5583: 		if self.vim - cost < 0 then
5584: 			local damage = (cost - (self.vim or 0)) * mult
5585: 			self:incVim(-self.vim or 0)
5586: 			self.life = self.life - damage  -- die_at life can't be used
5587: 		else
5588: 			return previous_incVim(self, v)
5589: 		end
5590: 	else
5591: 		return previous_incVim(self, v)
5592: 	end
5593: end
